🌸 Welcome to Sakura Springs!

You run a tiny hot spring & sushi stall for woodland friends.

🍣The sushi stallGuests order a dish. Tap it on the counter to cook, then tap to serve.
♨️The onsenSome guests want a warm soak. Seat them in the spring and hand them a towel.
🦊Woodland guestsEvery happy guest pays in 🌰 acorns. Rare spirits visit too — collect them all in your Album!

🎯 First goal: make 3 guests happy — earn a 🌰 50 gift!
